rawIntent: Angular ,Asp.Net core Webapi with CQRS pattern,SQL Lite databse

layers: PharmAPI.Api (Presentation / Web API Controllers / Swagger OpenAPI)
PharmAPI.Application (CQRS Commands, Queries, Handlers, Behaviors, DTOs, Interfaces)
PharmAPI.Domain (Entities, Value Objects, Domain Exceptions, Enums)
PharmAPI.Infrastructure (Persistence, EF Core DbContext, SQLite Repositories, External Services)

implementationPolicy.apiDesign: RESTful HTTP JSON endpoints with proper status codes and Swagger annotations
implementationPolicy.cqrs: Strict segregation of Commands and Queries using MediatR
implementationPolicy.solid: Clean Architecture with inverted dependencies and single responsibility handlers
implementationPolicy.cleanCode: Asynchronous I/O, domain rule encapsulation, structured error handling
